story.title: Sharad Kapoor reveals SRK, Salman, Javed Akhtar reached out to him
story.summary: Actor Sharad Kapoor expressed gratitude for the support from industry colleagues who reached out concerning his well-being. He highlighted calls and messages from prominent figures like Salman Khan and Shah Rukh Khan. Kapoor also discussed his health concerns, revealing he is prioritizing recovery while exploring new projects. Despite recent challenges, he remains hopeful about returning to acting

story.title: 'Ramayana' hits Rs 1,500 crore globally in record time
story.summary: Namit Malhotra's 'Ramayana', directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has crossed the Rs 1,000 crore mark domestically. The film achieved this milestone within just two weeks of its theatrical release. Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, it is now the sixth Indian film to reach this figure.
